page.overview:
Who is War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius characters?

The following is a list of characters from War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius.

;Minor Characters Daria Hourne: Baby daughter to Vinera and Dario. Soleius Leonis: Baby son to Machérie and Mont. 《Simulacra》4006_α: A Simulacra leading one of the 3 squads sent to Ardra. Her missions were to dispose of Melnia and find the Mournblade in her stead. Met her end at the hands of Garrousa after underestimating him. 《Simulacra》3112_β: A Simulacra leading one of the 3 squads sent to Ardra. In order to find the Mournblade, she tailed Ramada's group to the Netherglade, where she lost her life in battle. Rasheena Ovis: The youngest of the triplet princesses of Ovis. She is killed by Rundall soldiers after fleeing from Ovis castle in an attempt to seek help, although her father considered her nothing more than a diversion to facilitate Lucielle's escape. Rogaul: The corrupt chancellor of Wezette and mastermind of the royalist faction. Always held himself in the background while secretly enriching himself through various nefarious activities. His attempt to have Glaciela and Roseluna kill one another instead led to his own undoing at the hands of the former, with the Realmscourge devouring his soul afterwards. Harvas: A master swordsmith and father to Lemuré. He was poisoned by Garvall's Arms Dealer's Guild after refusing to work for them. Though he survived, he became severely disfigured. Sensing his coming demise, he summoned his two apprentices, Velric and Zachar, and had them fight over the right to become his successor. Biggs and Wedge: A pair of soldiers from Leonis who accompanied Elsirelle, Ildyra, Miranda and Karsha to an expedition into the Netherglade. Torus: A Leonisian soldier whose soul was devoured by the Realmscourge. A rumor of ghosts spread after fellow soldiers spotted what appeared to be his apparition after a lightning strike during a stormy night on the Hill of Heroes, below which the Realmscourge's carcass was buried. Volke: Lilyth's younger brother. He was killed when Fennes attacked his village. Zhord: King of Giala. In a time before Maevia married king Rhegis, talks about an alliance between Giala and Wezette fell through after Zhord's younger son was killed. After Zhord's elder son was killed as well after a failed attempt of revenge, Khury challenged him to a fight, with the winner getting to rule both countries. Unfortunately, the people of Giala instead resorted to mass suicide after their king's death, refusing to live under Khury's rule. Kharles: The eldest son of Zhord and prince of Giala. Maevia accepted him as a ward to the Wezette royal family to establish an alliance. Kharles used this opportunity to duel Khury for the throne in order to exact his revenge on the royal family, but lost the battle and his life in the process after nearly killing Maevia. Torex: Cyrelle's employer and a rich collector of arts whose life was targeted. Little Leela was apprehended as a suspect, but instead ended up solving the crime. It is unknown how much of the tale is true or made up by the girl. Gigot: Lord Torex' butler. He assassinated his master for revenge. Lord Torex had driven Gigot's father, a sculptor, to an early death after crippling his fingers to ensure he would no longer craft new works of art and devalue the ones in Torex' possession. Quill: The man who found Sadali and Exia after they had been washed ashore off Ardra's coast. His family went on to become Sadali's stewards. Thorbek: Quill's great-grandson and Sadali's steward in the final timeline before the current one. He accompanied Sadali to the final battle in the cave below Leonis. Raquille: A young boy from Locum, a village in Tessera. For foiling an attempt to kidnap the boy, Sadali was elevated to the rank of a priest. Vardia: Former Crystal Warrior of Light. Upon his death, his lingering regrets manifested in the form of a vision of himself, Astrius.
